views.name: title
views.title: Lily’s Rescue Boats
views.caption: All boats home: your lifeboat charging along under the lighthouse; Play (the Rescue Service), Rally (Lily’s race), Boats, Weather, Settings

views.name: title-wide
views.title: The title, on a bigger screen
views.caption: the menu to the right, as on the boards

views.name: boats
views.title: Choose your boat
views.caption: five lifeboats, a wheelhouse each in its own colour; your best with each

views.name: weather
views.title: The weather
views.caption: seven, from the boards: the title behind changes as you pick

views.name: settings
views.title: Settings
views.caption: how good the others are, which side the stick goes, sound, a new coast

views.name: start
views.title: Moored in the harbour
views.caption: as the count goes down, a look round the harbour: the five crews moored, bows to the mouth, the town on its hill behind; a few from the town on the quay to see them off

views.name: harbour
views.title: Setting out
views.caption: out through the harbour, the town on its hill, the lighthouses either side of the mouth

views.name: racing
views.title: Along the coast
views.caption: the first calls are just outside the harbour; everyone rescued so far (of everyone whose call has come in), how many are aboard your boat of the six it holds, the time with the weather as it is now; the map, a little boat another crew is going for ringed in their colour; the five crews’ counts under it

views.name: line
views.title: The line goes over
views.caption: alongside and slowed right down, the little boat in the lee of the hull: the crew throws a line; the camera cuts in

views.name: climb
views.title: Climbing aboard
views.caption: held steady, the water calm in the lifeboat’s lee: a crew member leans over the rail to take a hand, and up they come

views.name: open-sea
views.title: The open sea
views.caption: past the harbour’s headland the far shore falls away: islets and reefs out over the water, the swell bigger out here; the sun going down

views.name: rough
views.title: Rough water
views.caption: out at sea, beam-on in a bigger swell: they climb across more slowly, and the bar goes amber

views.name: deck
views.title: Full up
views.caption: six aboard and no more room: the deck full, the pill amber; time to take them home

views.name: landing
views.title: Safe ashore
views.caption: in through the mouth as night comes down: they step ashore one by one, to the crowd waving on the quay by the station; then back out, if anyone’s still waiting

views.name: podium
views.title: Everyone home
views.caption: everyone rescued, every crew in at the quay; then the crews’ honours, 1st to 5th by Lily’s rule

views.name: rally
views.title: Lily’s race
views.caption: the same coast as a race: your place and the places under the map; the last call when the first boat is home

views.name: rally-finish
views.title: The finish line
views.caption: the race’s finish: through the harbour mouth under the banner

views.name: rally-podium
views.title: 1st to 5th
views.caption: in at the quay, the places by most rescued

views.name: wide
views.title: On a bigger screen
views.caption: granite cliffs, sheltered water calmer and greener in the lee of the headlands, the wake churning white

views.name: study
views.title: The lifeboat
views.caption: navy hull, red below the waterline, RNLI along the bow; the wheelhouse in the boat’s own colour, a tall black mast; the crew in white helmets

views.name: weather-calm
views.title: Calm
views.caption: a gentle swell, little foam, gulls

views.name: weather-windy
views.title: Windy
views.caption: a bigger, steeper sea; whitecaps and streaks of foam; spray flying

views.name: weather-stormy
views.title: Stormy
views.caption: a big grey sea under a lid of cloud; rain, lightning, the beams already turning

views.name: weather-foggy
views.title: Foggy
views.caption: the coast lost in it; the lighthouses’ beams and the searchlight cut through

views.name: weather-night
views.title: Night
views.caption: stars, the moon on the water, windows lit, the beams turning, your searchlight ahead

views.name: weather-sunset
views.title: Sunset
views.caption: the sun low ahead, the sea gold and the cliffs warm

views.name: storm-wide
views.title: A storm, on a bigger screen
views.caption: the swell high enough to hide the next boat

views.name: night-wide
views.title: Night, on a bigger screen
views.caption: your searchlight on the water, the lighthouse beam sweeping the harbour mouth
